config._tax: Marketplace cut when you sell produce. VIP on the desert island = 12.5%.
config._builds: Skill builds to compare. Each one edits your live skills: remove skills, then add {skill: rank}.
config._herd: Chapter herd simulation. You sell to every bounty you can, except the animals listed in keep.
config._stop_feeding_at: Stop feeding an animal once it reaches this level; it waits awake (no cost) for a bounty. "auto" = highest level the boards ask for, null = always feed.
config._barn: Barn levels to compare (0 = no barn).
config._capacity: Slots per building level (sfl-manager). Chicken Coop adds +5 per Hen House level, Barn Blueprint +5 per Barn level.
config._board: Animal bounties per week per building level, by kind. Hen House L3 and Barn L3 from the SFL wiki; the other rows are guesses. Replaced by the live board when it has ticket bounties.
config._ticket_base: Base Duende Caps per animal ticket bounty. UNKNOWN until 9 Nov: placeholder values. Gems per gem bounty from the live board.
config._tickets: Chapter ticket plan. Bonus = VIP +2 (deliveries and chores only) and +1 per Duende wearable worn by you or a farm hand.
config._npcs: base = tickets before bonuses (sfl-manager, Cave Dwellers). freq = share of days you deliver. flower_per_ticket = sfl-manager average P2P cost (a + means some items have no market price).
config._board_bonus: Selling every non-animal board bounty gives +100 tickets a week (11 weeks with a bonus). Set to true if you do it.

bounties.source: sfl-manager land API, merged across refreshes
